title: Mobile Wallet Error-Resolution Timeframes (Remittance Transfer Rule)
content:
Compliance timetable for error notices on **Mobile Wallet** transfers.

| Tier | Calendar days after the disclosed date available within which an error notice may be given | Calendar days after a notice within which Paloma must decide it | Paloma business days to credit the money again after the customer chooses re-credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile Wallet Micro | 180 | 90 | 1 |
| Mobile Wallet Economy | 180 | 90 | 1 |
| Mobile Wallet Express | 180 | 90 | 1 |
| Mobile Wallet Express Plus | 180 | 90 | 1 |
| Mobile Wallet Priority | 180 | 90 | 1 |
| Mobile Wallet Large Amount | 180 | 90 | 2 |

- The notice window and the decision period are counted in calendar days.
- The re-credit period is counted in Paloma business days from the customer's choice of re-credit as a remedy.

*Hypothetical reading:* a notice given on a Mobile Wallet Large Amount transfer is decided within 90 calendar days, and a re-credit chosen after an error is found is made within 2 business days; on every other tier the re-credit period is 1 business day.
